name: Scandi Home
tagline: Light furniture and things for the home in a Scandinavian spirit
niche: Scandinavian furniture and home accessories store

listing.description: A website for a Scandinavian-style furniture and homeware store: objects on coloured plinths with a switchable palette, a catalogue filtered by category, an interiors mosaic and soft pastel tiles.

seo.title: Scandi Home — Scandinavian furniture in Tashkent
seo.description: Chairs, armchairs, sofas, tables and lamps in a light Scandinavian style. Showroom in Mirabad, delivery across Uzbekistan, assembly on the day of delivery.
seo.answer: Scandi Home is a Scandinavian furniture and homeware store in Tashkent with a showroom at 14 Mirabad St, open daily 10:00–20:00. An oak chair starts at 1,450,000 UZS, an armchair at 4,900,000 UZS, a sofa at 11,800,000 UZS. Delivery in Tashkent takes 1–2 days, across Uzbekistan up to 7 days, assembly is free.

sections.title: A home that feels light
sections.subtitle: Oak and ash furniture, soft fabrics and light that never glares. Everything you see here can be touched in our Mirabad showroom.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Fewer things, more air
sections.text: We gather furniture built to last: solid oak and ash, removable linen and wool covers, simple shapes with nothing extra. Some pieces we import, others we make to our own drawings in a workshop near Tashkent — that keeps the price below imports.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: Pieces you keep coming back to
sections.intro: Prices are for the piece in the base fabric or finish. Other colours and sizes in the showroom or by phone.

sections.label: Delivery
sections.title: From order to your first evening at home

items.title: You choose
items.text: Online or in the showroom: feel the fabric and sit down before you buy.

items.title: We confirm
items.text: We call back within 15 minutes to confirm colour, size and delivery date.

items.title: We deliver
items.text: In Tashkent 1–2 days, across Uzbekistan up to 7 days, in a two-hour window that suits you.

items.title: We assemble
items.text: Free assembly on delivery day; we take the packaging away.

items.quote: The Hygge armchair has stood by the window for a year — we have washed the cover three times and it looks new.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: The table arrived the next day and was assembled on the spot. The oak smells of wood, not varnish.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: We spent an hour choosing the sofa fabric in the showroom — nobody rushed us.
items.author: Madina

items.q: Can I see the furniture in person?
items.a: Yes, the showroom at 14 Mirabad St is open daily 10:00–20:00.
Free in Tashkent for orders from 5,000,000 UZS, otherwise 150,000 UZS. To the regions at the carrier’s rate.
Yes, sofas and armchairs come in 12 fabrics. Making a piece in another fabric takes 14–21 days.
Cash, Uzcard or Humo card, or bank transfer. Instalments are available through a partner bank.
Five years on the frame, one year on mechanisms and fabric.
